name: Paperpal
tagline: Paperpal is an AI writing assistant for academic and scientific papers, built by Cactus Communications. It checks grammar and language quality and suggests edits aligned with a target journal's style and formatting requirements before submission. Researchers and medical writers use it to cut down manuscript revision cycles.
